bounded_research_scope: SOS archive/allcounty directory, actual county landing plus bounded relevant election/map hops, full statewide2024/2026 originals and native service; unvisited app internals/later resolutions remain unapproved external qualifications, no pending build dependency
incidental_selector_attempts: Early GIS substring also matched reGIStration; three irrelevant business/rental URLs failed and a Sierra registration form was received. Their full bounded receipts/bodies survive; not map coverage. Corrected to word-boundary GIS and stopped unrelated traversal.
geographic_findings: RGIS ZIPs are general-reference precinct geography with separate source vintages; neither approves November 2026 reporting units.
The SOS base map is an archived county map, not a result-label crosswalk.
Native VTD/GEOCODE/VTD_NUM/ID and Census county FIPS have distinct meanings; count/name equality establishes no child identity.
County individual-precinct PDF is155,242,680 exact bytes/30pages, reconstructed from7ordered lossless chunks; its map label is2022 despite the containing link’s2021 label.
